dbe skrun gab5ba bshad/gtan tshigs rig pa'am tshad ma rig pa zhes pa 'di ni rig pa'i gnas che ba lnga'i nang gses gzung ba yul du gyur pa'i dngos po gang dang gang mchis pa de dag 'dzin pa blos mngon sum mam rjes dpag gi tshad mas yongs su bzhal nas dngos po so so'i mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi tshang ba'i ngo bo gtan la 'bebs pa'i rig pa khyad par can grub mtha' ris su ma chad pas bslab par bya ba zhig yin gshis gangs ri'i ljongs su gnas pa'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas su gyur cing / dar khyab kyang chen po byung ste rgya gar gyi gzhung lugs dang bong/ kyi mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs rgyas bsdus bgrang las 'das pa zhig mchis kyang / bar lam g.yon gyi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen ngan pa'i rkyen pas bshad khrid kyi rgyun ches cher nyams shing / tha na dpe rgyun yang brlag la nye bar slebs yod kyang /tang gi skabs bcu gcib/ pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa nas bzung zing bcos yo bsrang gi srid jus yang dag pa'i 'og deng rabs can bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba'i ched du mi rnams kyi shes rig gi chu tshad sgo kun nas gong du spel byed slob gso'i las don la shugs sdon rgyag dgos pa'i skabs su bab pa'i dgosamakhor dmigs te 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas mkhas grub rje'i(sde bdun yid kyi mun sel〉dang / bse ngag dbang chos grags kyi bsdus gra mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan skal bzang re ba kun skong〉sogs dpe tshan kha shas par skrun byed mus yin lags shing / dezhi nang nas bse ngag dbang bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i〈tshad ma'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos chen po rnam 'grel gyi don gcig tu dril ba blo rab 'bring tha ma gsum du ston pa legs bshad chen po ‘

mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan skal bzang re ba kun skong〉zhes pa 'di ni cha pa chos kyi seng ges tshad ma'i gzhung lugs kun gyi snying po'am gnad rnams phyogs dril ba bod rang lugs kyi bsdus gra'i rnam gzhag gsar gtod mdzad pa'i dgongs don rnams nyams su len pa'i gang zag rnams kyi blo dang 'tshams par rim bzhin 'jug pa'i gzhung lugs su thog mar bsdus chung ste kha dog dkar dmar nas spyi dang bye brag gi bar bsdus tshan brgyad dang / de nas 'gal 'grel chung ba nas khas len song tshul bar bsdus tshan drug de nas drug sgra nas rgyu 'bras che ba'i bar bsdus tshan bcu gnyis bcas khyon le tshan nyer drug tu gtan la phab ste 'jug bde zhing / dbus gtsang dang mdo khams kyi bshad grwa chen po tshang mas tshad mar 'dzin pa zhig yin stabs de'i ma yig sku 'bum byams pa gling gi par ma zhig dang / de'i sdom tshig tu(bsdus grwa'i rtsa tshig dwangs gsal me long〉zhes pa gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i par ma bcas rtsa 'grel gnyis yig nor dang tha snyad gcig gyur bzo bcos ma byas thabs med rnams ma gtogs de byings ma dpe ltar dang / gzhung gi bsdus tshan so so'i 'gor le tshan de rang gi rtsa tshig rnams bar 'jug re byas te bkod yod par ma zad/ tshad ma'i dmigs bsal tha snyad dang / gzhan yang tha snyad gal che ba go dka' ba rnams blo gsar rnams kyis rtogs par sla ba'i ched du dge bu'i bshes gnyen dmu ge bsam gtan laṭa su snyan gtser nan zhus kyis mchan 'grel khag brgya dang sum cu so gcig gsham du bkod yod pa bcas cha rkyen gyis gang 'grub gzab nan zhus khul yang /bdag cag rnams gzhung lugs kyi sbyangs pa med pa sgo'i phyi rol gyi mi lta bu yin gshis sgrig stangs thad la skyon dang nor 'khrul yang nges par du yong srid pa de dag la klog pa po mkhyen ldan rnams kyis skyon 'don dang legs bcos dgongs 'char lhug por yod pa nas slad par skrun skabs skyon sangs dag bcos zhus chog pa bcas zab rol zhu//

dkar chagabasdus grwa'i rtsa tshig dwangs gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs legs so/ / su nyi za shaka 1tshad ma'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos chen po rnam 'grel gyi don gcig tu dril ba blo rab 'bring ba gsum du ston pa legs bshad chen po mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan skal bzang re ba kun skong zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ngag dbang bkra shis/ 35bstan bcos kyi sngon 'gro 'go brjod/ 37gzhung don/ 37dang po/ dbyibs dang kha dog sogs kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 39gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 40rang lugs gzhag pa/ 44rtsod pa spong ba/ 48gnyis pa/ yod rtogs med rtogs kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 50gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 51rang lugs gzhag pa/ 54rtsod pa spong ba/ 56gsum pa/ yin log min log gi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 571

gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 58rang lugs gzhag pa/ 65bzhi pa/ ldog pa ngos 'dzin gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 65gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 66rang lugs gzhag nga / 70lnga pa/ gcig dang tha dad kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 70gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 72rang lugs gzhag pa/ 77rtsod pa spong ba/ 80drug pa/ rgyu 'bras chung ngu'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 82gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 83rang lugs gzhag pa/ 9/rtsod pa spong ba/ 92bdun pa/ yul dang yul can gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 96gzhan phugs dgag pa/ 99rang lugs gzhag pa/ 105rtsod pa spong ba/ 110brgyad pa/ spyi dang bye brag gi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 112gzhan lugs dgag pa/ — 114rang lugs gzhag pa/ 126rtsod pa spong ba/ 127dgu pa/ 'gal 'brel gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 127gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 128rang lugs gzhag pa/ 133rtsod pa sprong ba/ 135

bcu4 pa/ mtshan mtshon gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 137gzhan lugs dbag pa/ 138bcu gcig pa/ cha pa'i luṭa kyi rdzas ldog gi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 146gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 147bcu gnyis pa/ rang lugs kyi rdzas ldog gi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 161gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 162rang lugs gzhag pa/ 166rtsod pa spong ba/ 167bcu gsum pa/ khyab mtha' 'god tshul gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 169gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 169rang lugs gzhag pa/ 172rtsod pa spong ba/ — 172bcu bzhi pa/ khyab pa sgo brgyad kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 173gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 173bco lnga pa/ khas len song tshul gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 177gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 179rang lugs gzhag pa/ 192rtsod pa spong ba/ 193bcu drug pa/ drug sgra'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 19 gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 196bcu bdun pa/ thal 'gyur chung ngu'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 217gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 221rang lugs gzhag pa/ 229rang lugs/ 231

rang lugs/ 249bco brgyad pa/ dus gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 250ga'an lugasadagag pa/ 252rang lugs gzhag pa/ 258rtsod pa spong ba/ 259bcu dgu pa/ rang mtshan dang spyi mtshan gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 261gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 263rang lugs gzhag pa/ 267rtsod pa spong ba/ 268nyi shu pa/ sel 'jug dang sgrub 'jug gi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 270gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 271rang lugs gzhag pa/ 277rtsod ba spong ba/ 278nyer gcig pa/ rigs brjod dang tshogs brjod kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 279gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 281rang lugs gzhag pa/ 284rtsod pa spong ba/ 287nyer gnyis pa/ dgag sgrub kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 289gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 290rang lugs gzhag pa/ 295nyer gsum pa/ gzhan sel gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 298gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 299rang lugs gzhag pa/ 30lha

nyer bzhi pa/ 'gal 'brel che ba'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 302gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 303rang lugs gzhag pa/ 308rtsod pa spong ba/ 311nyer lnga pa/ thal 'gyur che ba'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 312gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 313rang lugs gzhag pa/ 318rtsod pa spong ba/ 319nyer drug pa/ rgyu 'bras che ba'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 320gzhan lugs dgag pa/ 322rang lugs gzhag pa/ 334rtsod pa spong ba/ 335mjug bsdu ba/ 335dres men gter gyi kha byang bzhugs/ 337rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ 373
༄7//gasdug gzhi ce chig dwadasu gsug she zhod zhesu byu ga gzhugasu zhegasu snyo/ su dhi pra sha gas brtsams pa/

shes bya'i rnam pa kun gsal snang ba'i mdzod/ /ye shes dri ma med ba'i 'od zer 'bum/ thar 'dod blo yi chu skyes bzhad pa'i dpal/ /yab rje 'jas dbyangs bla mas dge legs stsol/ /mtha' yas gsung rab gting zab yangs pa'i mtshor/ /bde blag 'jug pa rigs lam sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /thub bstan kun gsal bzhin ras mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /blo gros lang tsho dar ba'i mchod sbyin spel/ /tshad ma'i gnad bsdus tshogs pa bsdus pa'i grwa/ /'di la spyi don bye brag de nyid sde/ /dbang pos rigs lam chung sogs mtshan gzhir brtag /mi mthun smras pa'i zhe 'dod dpyod pa'i dngos/ /gang la gang gis rtsod pa snga phyi'i rgol/ /rgyu mtshan gang gis gang du ci zhig rtsod/ /rtags gsal rtsod gzhi zhes grags rtog ge'i skad/ khams dang skye mched phung po mkhas bya'i gnas/ /rang dbang bdag mi dmigs pa bdag med don/ /yod med kun te shes bya yod pa chos/ /gzhi grub don gcig tshad mas grub pa dang / /rang gi ngo bo 'dzin dang tshad mas dmigs/ /blo yi yul du bya rung ldog ste rim/ /dbye ba rtag dngos rang spyi bden pa gnyis/ /'jig med chos ni rtag go gzhi mthun dpyad/ /res 'ga' ba dang rnam pa thams cad gnyis/ /don byed nus pa dngos po'i don te gsum/ /gzugs shes ldan min phung po lngar yang dbye/ /gzugs rung gzugs kyi mtshan nyid phyi nang gnyis/ /shes rgyud kyis bsdus ma bsdus gzugs rung sbyor/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phyi yi lnga/ /mig shes sogs kyi bzung bya rim bzhin don/ /dang por kha dog dbyibs gnyis nyi shur yang / / kun btus mngon par skabs yod phra rags rdul/ /rig byed nam mkha' rgyan 3

gsung snga phyir brtag /sgra la zin pa'i 'byung 'gyur de las gzhan/ /ston dang snyan par zla bcas bzhi tshan gnyis/ /rjod byed sgra ni brjod bya'i don go byed/ /rnga sgra khyad can yin min ston dang gzhan/ /lhan skyes sbyar byung dri yang zhim dang min/ /ro la rtsa ba yan lag nyi nga lag gis/ /drug dang dgu bzhi brgya rtsa re gsum gsungs/ /bcu gcig reg bya 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyis/ /rang 'bras rnam shes bskyed pa'i rigs gnas kyi/ /nang gi gzugs can dang ba mig dbang sogs/ /rang yul mthong ba rten bcas de mtshungs gzhan/ /bsdus dang skabs yod yang dag blangs pa dang / /kun btags dbang 'byor chos kyi skye mched gzugs/ /gsal zhing rig pa shes ba'i mtshan nyid de/ /tshad ma tshad min blo rig drug dang bdun/ /tshad ma gsar du mi bslu ba yi shes/ /ma ngon rjes gnyis so tshad min lnga yang dbye/ /'du byed gang zhig mtshungs par mi ldan pa'i/ /rigs su gnas pa ldan min 'du byed don/ /gang zag dang ni de min dngos po sogs/ /'di dag tshad bsdus don gyi lus so zungs/ /kha dog dmar sngon sogs su ma nges te/ /chos dung dkar po tshe mtha' yas pa'i mdog /rtsa ba'i mdog bzhi 'dren tshul nag por dpyad/ /dmar ser ljang gu yan lag brgyad las gzhan/ /de dag dmar ser nag dang ser po'i cha/ /dri ro gzugs kyang kha dog skye mched min/ /rdul du grub pa bem po'i mtshan nyid de/ /mdog dang dbyibs su rung ba kha dog dbyibs/ /dkar dmar sngo ser rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi/ /yan lag sprin dang du ba rdul khug sna//snang mun grib ma nyi ma'i 'od zer brgyad/ /phra rab rdul nas nyi zer rdul bar phye/ khug sna 'ja' tshon na bun lho 'ur ma/ /nyi 'od snang ba de bzhin phyi nang brtag ring thung mtho dma' lham blum phywa le min/ /rtsa ba yan lag mdog gnyis mu bzhi ste/ kha dog dbyibs kyang de bzhin dkar dmar dang / /sa

chu sogs la mya bzhi'i gnyis re 'byung / /'byung ba sra zhing 'thas pa rlan zhing gsher/ /tsha zhing sreg pa yang zhing g.yo ba bzhi/ /'byung 'gyur 'jam rtsub lci yang grang bkres skom/ /yang ba 'byung 'gyur 'on kyang rlung yang de/ /rnam 'grel lci yang gzugs nyid sdig lci rtog /rta dkar gang zag phyir na dkar po mi na/ /rtsod gzhi blang dang khyod sgra'i zhib cha gces/ /gser ni sra zhing 'thas mod sa ma yin/ /bsreg dang 'jal la mi mthun smras pa mtshar/ /phywa le ba de yin min dngos 'gal te/ /dgag sgra zung dang yin min log pas phye/ /shes bya yod rtogs tshad ma yod na yang / /dngos rtogs tshad ma med de dngos med phyir/ /don byed nus stong dngos med mtshan nyid do/ /dngos por med rtogs tshad ma yod gyur kyang / /rtag rtogs tshad ma —yod min med pa kun/ /de ni chos ma yin phyir rtag mi 'gyur/ /byas na ma byas par rtogs tshad ma zung / /ma byas byas rtogs tshad ma gnyis gsum spel/ /de bzhin yod med rtogs pa'i tshad ma yang / /rtag rtogs tshad ma med rtogs tshad yod kyang / /de gnyis gang yang med pa dngos po kun/ /'di la snga phyi yod med mu yang bzhi/ /dngos rtogs tshad ma med rtogs tshad ma dang / /med rtogs dngos rtogs labasgres rigs pa rtsen/ /der rtogs tshad ma yod dang de yin pa/ /khyab mnyamayod med rtag dngos kun la mtshungs/ /rtag phyir der rtogs tshad ma dngos rtogs dang / /chos kun yod rtogs tshad ma dngos rtogs tshad/ /yod rtogs dngos rtogs gcig yod ya zung kun/ /tshad ma khas blangs la song rigs pa'i gnad/ /dngos med rtogs pa brtsegs la rtag rtogs min/ /bum pa rtag par rtogs pa'i tshad ma ni/ /med pa nyid phyir dngos rtogs yod re skan/ /shes bya dngos rtogs med rtogs yod rtogs srid/ /gang zhig yod na med cing med na yod/ /med rtogs tshad ma'o rigs pa'i srang mdor stos/ /

bum pa dngos phyir dngos po min las log /shes pa yin las log ste shes min phyir/ /bem phyir gzugs dang shes pa'i gzhi mthun med/ /sgra dri gzugs ma yin log phyi yi gzugs/ /'on kyang bum pa ka ba yin las log/ka bum gzugs kyi skye mched sgra sogs gzhan/ /tsandan dang ni de'i dri sa yi bum/ /bum dang ka ba'i kha dog dbyibs dag dpyod/ /rnam mkhyen dngos po yinalog zung du rigs/ /ya min de dang dngos med yin khyab mnyam/ /bem shes ldan min 'du byed gang yin dngos/ /rnam mkhyen tshad ma nyid phyir shes rig go/sgra sogs dngos kun rang nyid mi rtag pa/ /ldan min 'du byed phyir na dngos por nges/ /yod pa dngos med ma yin pa las log /dngos med dang ni don byed nus stong phyir/ /don byed nus na rang 'bras bskyed dgos la/ /yod pa'i 'bras bu med de rtag phyir ro/ /med pa min las log na med pa ste/ /tshad mas mi dmigs pa yis med par mtshon/ /rnam mkhyen dang ni tshad mas ma gzhal gang / /dngos med rtag pa ma byas min las log /byas min ma byas de min byas pa'o/ /byas phyir mi rtag skad cig ma de'i don/ /med pa yin log yong nges min log med/ /nam mkha' rtag pa yin log min sogs bzhi/ /gcig gnyis rtag min gsum bzhi rtag par nges/ — /rtag pa yin min yin log cha da nga ya/ /yin kyang rtag min rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i thugs/ /chos kun dngon rtogs mkhyen pa de'i mtshan nyid/ /bum pa rtag pa yin pa las log kyang / /de steng rtag pa yin log gang dran 'gyur/ /dngos po ma yin las log dngos por yang / /snga phyi yin log min log bsgol te gzhig /dngos por min log rang mtshan gzhan sel skabs/ /yin min log pa yod med mu bzhi ste/ /yin log min la min log yin skad kyang / /bzlog ste mu bzhi bum pa'i spyi la sogs/ /sgra ni dngos po'i ldog min gzhi ldog ste/ /mtshan gzhi nyid do ldog min

tha dad phyir/ /gser bum bum pa'i gzhi ldog mtshan gzhi min/ /don byed nus pa dngos po'i don ldog ste/ /dngos po'i 'jog byed mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ /'on kyang ldog par mi rigs gcig ma yin/ /dngos dang gcig na mtshon byar thal bar 'gyur/ /tshul de gzugs shes rtag dngos kun la mtshungs//chos de'i ldog kyang de min ka bum gnyis/ /bum pa dang ni gcig gyur bum pa yang / /de yi ldog min de dang tha dad phyir/ /de dang gcig na de dang khyab mnyam dgos/ /gser bum bum pa spyi dang ga la gcig /sto sdir chu skyor zhabase zhum bum pa'i mtshan/ /gser bum phyir na bum par tha dad kyang / /bzlog ste ma yin gser bum bum pa'o/ /bum pa'i ldog pa bum pa dang ni gcig /gnyis ka rtag phyir bum pa'i ldog pa min/ /gzhan sel phyir na de gnyis sdog pa'o/ /chos kun rang nyid rang gi ldog pa nyid/ /gzugs sgra ldog pa ma yin sgrub par gnas/ /bum pa min dang de dang tha dad las/ /ldog kyang de min zangs bum med pa'o/ /phyi ma bum par gcig min tha mi dad/ /rnam mkhyen dang ni tha dad las log chos/ /rnam mkhyen sdog pa'i don te chos kun 'dra/ /rang ldog gzhi ldog don ldog sgras brjod tsar / /gcig gnyis tsam dang gsum ldan dbye bar rtog /ngo bo gcig kyang tha dad mi rtag dngos/ /rang bzhin bdag nyid ngo bo gcig rnams mnyam/ /dngos dang mi rtag phan tshun tha dad la/ /yod dang med pa phan tshun tha dad min/ /shes bya dang ni rtag pa ngo bo gcig / rdzas gcig ma yin rdzas phyir dngos por 'gyur/ /ka bum gnyis ni dngos po'i bye brag phyir/ /de dang ngos gcig na'ang rdzas tha dad/ /shes bya nyid phyir shes byar ngo bo gcig /rtag pa de bzhin dngos por rgyu 'bras dbye/ /ba lang dkar nag rig sa gcig mthong tsam nas/ /'dra ba'i blo bskyed ldog pa rigs gcig go /'on kyang 7

'brel med bdag nyid tha dad lo/ /rta dang ba lang shes byar rigs gcig ste/ /ngo bo tha dad tha dad phyir yang ngo / /rigs mi 'dra ba gzhag tu yod pa yis/de gnyis rigs mi 'dra bar bsgrub nus pa'ang dpyod/ /rnam 'grel cha dang kun nas 'dra ba brtag /ston dang 'dra ba'i sems can sogs kyis rgol/ /bum pa dang ni khang pa'i nam mkha' gnyis/ /rigs gcig dgag bya thogs reg nyid bkag lo/ /de gnyis dgag bya'i thogs reg 'gal ba'am/ /bum med thogs reg bkag tsam min no lo/ /gzugs kyi chos nyid shes pa'i chos nyid kyi/ /dgag bya rigs gcig de yi mtshan nyid 'tshol/ /thogs reg bkag tsam med dgag nam mkha'i don/ /sgrub min der gyur ldog pa rigs gcig 'gal/ /de phyir ka bum mi rtag dgag sgrub gzhan/ /grub bde gcig pa skye 'gag gnas gsum mnyam/ /grub bde rdzas gcig dngos kyi nyer lena'ang gcig /slar yang phan tshun mngon sum mthong ba la/ /gegs med grub bde dbyer med rdzas gcig go /rdzas gcig grub bde gcig par mu bzhi 'ong / /'byung bzhi gzugs dri la sogs rdul rdzas brgyad/ /phan tshun rdzas gzhan yan lag can dang gcig /rdzas rigs gcig kyang rdzas gcig ma nges te/ /nas rdog gcig skyes nas 'bru che chung ngo / /'dir yang snga phyir mu bzhir a re mtshar/ /gcig gi mtshan nyid so so min pa'i chos/ /rang ldog ngo bo rigs gcig gsum du brjod/ /so so min pa tha mi dad kyi don/ /rang ldog so so min sogs sbyor tshul 'dra/ /ldog pa rdzas kyis rigs gcig rnam pa gnyis/ /snga ma sgrub dang dgag par gyur pas kyang / /gang gis yid gtad tsam nas blo mthun 'jug /gzhan du skal mnyam ris mthun gsung bang 'byor/ /dgag gyur ba lang dag gi blo ji 'dra/ /sgrub pa'i gzugs shes ldan min rigs mthun gsum/ /lhas mchod mig shes 'dra na lha mi'i soms/ /tsan dan shug pa 'dra phyir gser zangs kyang / dgag

bya rigs gcig bkag tsam med dgag gzhan/ /bdag med mkha' dang ri bong rwa med dbye/ /dngos kyi nyer len gcig skyes rdzas rigs gcig /'jim pa gcig gis bskyed ba'i rdza bum gnyis/ /sprul gzhi gcig gis bskyed pa'i lha miskobargya/ /tshul 'dir ngo mtshar rigs pa'i ri mo 'bum/ /rdzas gcig tha dad rdzas kyis skye bar sbyor/ /tha dad mtshan nyid so so ba yi chos/ /dbye ba mtshan nyid gzhi yang sngar bzhin gsal/ /ldog pa rdzas rigs tha dad mu bzhi lo/ /gser zangs bum pa'i rdzas dang ngo bo gcig /de gnyis rdzas kyang gzhan zhes zhib cha'ang gsungs/ /rang rgyu gser dang de las skyes pa'i khyad/ /shes bya yod pa yin phyir rdzas so so/ /min pa'i chos so 'on kyang rdzas gcig min/ /yod med yod cing bzlog na med zer yang / /'dir ni gnyis ka med kyang tha dad lo/ /dngos po kho na dngos dang rdzas yin mod/ /de dang dngos po rdzas min ya mtshan no/ /shes bya gzhi grub rgyu 'bras gang yang min/ /rgyu min 'bras med rtag pa nyid phyir dang / /'bras min skyed byed rgyu med ma skyes pa/ /gzugs sogs rgyu 'bras min yang de gnyis te/ skyes phyir rgyu yod rgyu las skyes nges sam/ /snga phyir byung ba'i 'bras dang rgyu yin dngos/ /skad cig tha ma'i glog ni nyer len min/ /gzugs phyir skad cig tha ma dngos gsungs dka'/ /rgyun gyi mtshan nyid snga phyi yod pa'i dngos/ /skad cig snga ma'i— rgyun yang rgyun min nam/ /phyi ma'i rgyun med rgyun bcas dngos po min/ /skad cig tsam gyis rgyun ni 'chad kha ma//nyon mongs rgyun dang sa bon ya mtha' gang / /bum pa'i rgyu la de yi nyer len du/ /ma nges bum pa'i rgyur gyur skyes bu'o/ /skyes bu'i rtsol byung rang rgyu'i sbyor ram min/ /nyer len yin na rdzas rgyun snga mar 'gyur/ /gang zag bem po bzlog ste'ang 'gyur min la/ /dngos po'i rgyu yi bum med snga logs yod/ /

dngos de 'bras 'gyur de byung 'brel bas gnod/ /bdag med phyir na dngos po yod par nges/ /me ni du ba'i rgyu yin tsan dan me/ /du ba'i rgyu ra 'gal rgyu 'bras gar yod brtag /tsan dan med kyang shugs me du ba 'khrigs/ /bum par 'gyur nges de yi rgyur ma nges/ /rdza bum rgyu yi 'jim pa der 'gyur nges//'bras la 'gyur nges rgyu la gyur zin grub/ /gzhan du rgyu 'bras 'brel ba'i nges pa bkag /rnam shes sa bon de yi nyer len kyang / /dngos kun sa bon ldan min rigs gcig go /dge ba lung ma bstan dang mi dger 'gyur/ /phyi rol dngos la rigs mi mthun kyang ngam/ /dngos de'i sa bon dngos rgyur ma nges sam/ /rgyal dang 'gro ba'i sa bon mtshams kyang rtog /snga phyir byung ba dngos dang brtsegs na brgyud/ /phyi logs gnyis steng snga logs byung ba ni/ /dngos 'bras rgyu la khyab byed 'bras la sbyor/ /gzugs kyi 'bras bu gzugs kyi dngos 'bras te/ /dngos brgyud phyi logs gcig gnyis gang yang min/ /snga phyir byung ba 'dir dngos grub pa brtag /skyed byed rgyu dang bskyed bya 'bras bu'i don/ /dngos brgyud rgyu 'bras gnyis kyang dngos zhes sbyar/ /nyer len lhan cig byed pa'i rgyu yang gnyis/ /rang gi rdzas rgyun yin min rdzas su bskyed/ /gser bum rgyu yi gser dang bzo rigs mkhan/ /dngos po skyed byed yin yang dngos po'i min/ /snga phyir byung ba'i dngos min 'bras dang rgyu/ /dus mnyam byung ba'i ngangos kyang rgyu 'bras 'gal/ /rtag min der gyur rgyu 'bras yod med dbye/khyod sgras phyung ba'i de byung khyad par khegs/ /ka bum rgyu dang bum pa'i rgyu gnyis 'gal/ re re'i dgag gzhi gnyis kyis bzlog na min/ /dajos po'i sngon du mi rtag rgyu 'bras med/ /de'i rgyu yod mod dngos yod dus sbyar ma/ /dngos por 'gyur nges gyur zin gzugs shes dang / /ka bum nyer len gyur ma khad kyang brtag /10

blo rig gang rung yul la med pa 'ang / /de ni rtog pa'i yul te blo yi min/ /me da 'dzin rtog pa'i yul du bya rung bkag /rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen yul bdag med kun/ /yul phyir gzhal bya tshad mas dmigs par 'gyur/ /yul can shes par ma nges rjod byed sgra/ /rjod byed sgra la brjod bya yod nges sam/ /dngos dang zhen pa'i brjod bya'i mtshan gzhir rtog /mu stegs gzhung gi dgos sogs rnam rtog mched/ /gzhan yang mig sogs sangs 'phags 'gro ba kun/ /yod na khyod kyi gzhal byar nges na yang / /rtag pa rnam mkhyen gzhal bya med ces 'dzer/ /lugs 'dir gang zag yin phyir ldan min te/ /gang zag rdzas btags dbye ba mi 'byed skad/ /mngon sum snang yul mi rtag dngos med shugs/ /'dir ni rnam mkhyen dngos yula'ang mi rtag gsungs/ /chos kun cig char mngon sum rtogs pa ci/ /sde bdun ma nges yul rnam 'char tshul bzhi/ /bum 'dzin rtog la de min las log par/ /snang ba don spyi snang bzung rtog med dpyad/ /'dzin stangs dmigs yul zhen yul snga mar nges/ /gang zag 'dzin stangs zhen yul gsungs par dogs/ /snang dang bzung bas snang yul bzung yula'ang min/ /rnam 'grel skrar snang don med can tshig gis/ /snang yul yod med skad kyang yod par nges/ /log shes zhen yul med la mos sgom yang / /sgra dang med pa med 'dzin dmigs yul dbye / /dmigs rnam gcig byas ma byas tshul yang ngo / /sgra spyi tsam 'dzin de 'dzin thos byung ngam/ /bdag 'dzin 'dzin tshul med pa 'dod kyang mchi/ /bum pa sgra spyi tsam 'dzin shugs yul te/ /zhen yul med ces zer la ba ngag 'dzin gnod/ /rang rig yid shes sems dang sem sa byung gzhan/ /sems yid skye mched rnam shes phung khams 'dra/ /yid dang yid shes mu bzhir don mthun sogs/ /shes kun tshad mar ma nges log shes sogs/ /tshad ma mngon sum ma yin rjes dpag 11

kyang / /snga ma rtog bral gzhan ni rtog pa nyid/ /tshad mas gzhal bar bya ba yul gyi don/ /sde bdun ge par bya zhing rig bya gsungs/ /rang gi cha shas du ma 'dus pa yi/ /gzugs rung phung po smos don cha med rtsod/ /rang yul rang stobs kyis myong sems byung tshor/ /tshor drug re rer bde sdug btang stoms khams/ /'du shes mtshan ma ra 'dzin pa'i cha nas bzhag /bkrar 'dzin yang ngo rim bzhin dbang yid shes/ /'du byed snga phyi'i phung po bzhi las gzhan/ /ldan min dang ni mtshungs ldan 'du byed gnyis/ /phyi ma rang dang mtshungs ldan yod pas phye/ /tshor 'du las gzhan gcig dman lnga bcu'o/ /rang 'khor sems byung yod pa'i rnam shes drug /rang yul la 'jug chos ni yul can te/ /sgra dbang shes pa ldan min bzhir yang dbye/ /shes par rang rig gzhan rig dag gi don/ /'dzin rnam don rig ther te skabs don soms/ /re rer tshad ma tshad min don mthun kyang / /gzhan rig sems dang sems byung ci rigs nyid/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid rnam shes mthun dgos ci/ /'khor du 'gro yul sems yod sems byung ste/ /kun btus kun 'gro yul nges lnga gnyis bcu/ /rtsa nyon drug dang nye nyon bcu phrag gnyis/ /dge ba bcu gcig gzhan 'gyur bzhi dang bcas/ /lnga dor mdzod du lhag ma bzhi bcu drug /ma rig lta bar nyon mongs can zhes sbyar/ /shin sbyangs sems kyi 'du byed btang stoms 'dir//shes bzhin shes rab sdang med mi 'tshar brtag /lugs 'dir mngon sum rtog bral ma 'khrul shes/ /dbang mngon lnga dang yid kyi gsum yang ngo / /sgra don 'dres rung don spyi don du 'khrul /zhen rig rtog pa don spyi ma shar sogs/ /gsar du mi bslu'i zhen rig rjes dpag ste/ /dngos stobs lung gi tshad ma grags pa'i gsum/ /tshad min ma rtogs log rtog the tshom ste/ /dang po snang la ma nges gzhan dang gsum/ /'di dang log rtog dbye tshul mi 'dra lo/ /12

mngon rjes dngos su rtogs bya mngon lkog ste/ /rim par dngos dang yod par don gcig 'dir/ /mngon sum rnam mkhyen dngos shugs gzhal bya 'gal/ /skog gyur lkog tu gyur nges cig shos dpyad/ /bstan bcos rnam dag bslu med lung tshad ma/ /'brel sgra bsdus dang ma bsdus tshad ma gnyis/ /rig byed don ldan rigs gzhung nyi ma 'bar/ /rigs min smra pa'i kurdo'i 'dab ma zum/ /bdag med na'ang spyi dang bye brag gis/ /ma bsdus med pa bsdus na yod tshul sla/ /dngos po spyi dang bye brag gnyis ka ste/ /rang gi bye brag dang ni spyi yod phyir/ /bum pa dngos po de dang bdeg gcig 'brel/ /dngos la bum pa ma yin du ma'i phyi ra/ /de dang bdag nyid gcig sgos tha dad la/ /dngos med bum pa med pas 'brel bar grub/ /dngos dang bdag nyid tha dad snga phyi'i bum/ /bdag med phyir yang gzugs shes dngos po yod/ /dngos po shes bya'i bye brag chos gsum mtshungs/ /dngos dang don byed nus pa'i spyi gnyis la/ /mu bzhi mtshan mtshon rigs pas mur yang brtag /dngos dang mi rtag spyir yang mtshan mtshon mu/ /rtag pa'i spyi yi spyi la bye brag gi /bye brag ma zad bye brag spyir yang bzlog /rtag pa'i spyi dang bye brag ma yin pa'i /spyi dang bye brag zung du rtag pa mthun/ /dngos po'i spyi dang bye brag gnyis yin bkag /phyi mar dngos po ma sbyar rigs pa dang / /gcig tu rtogs pa'i tshad ma mi rtag 'phen//mu bzhi yod pa'i dngos ni ldan min sogs/ /spyi dang bye brag gang rung ma yin pa'i/ /gnyis po bkag phyir yod na gang rung nges/ /bye brag ma yin gang zhig spyi yis rtsod/ /shes bya'i spyi gsal gang rung ma yin pa/ /spyir 'gal de yi spyi gsal gang min pa'i/ /spyi dang bye brag mu bzhi gnyis yin spyi/ /gang rung yin min bsgol pa'i pha mtha' gang / /bye brag phyir na shes bya yod pa'i yang / /rtag pa'i spyi dang dngos po'i spyi gang rung / /min dang bum pa'i spyi dang ka ba'i 13

spyi/ /gang rung bum pa'i spyi ste dang sgra dang / /gang rung 'brel ba zhig pas snga ma go /'on kyang de steng mtshan mtshon sbyar ba na/ /gang rung bar mas snga gnyis gcig tu bsdus/ /de lta dang sgra dang po 'byed pa'i tshig /snga mar mi 'dra rigs pa'i gsang tshig dgrol/ /rang gi gsal ba du mar rjes 'gro'i chos//spyi yi don de tshogs rigs sgra don bzhi/ /dang po cha shas mang 'dus gzugs rags pa/ /rigs spyi rigs la rjes 'gro spyi dang mthun/ /sgra spyi don spyi rtog pa de dang der/ /sgra dang don du snang zhing dngos min gsungs/ /snga phyi'i spyi zung dag la mu bzhi gnyis/ /sgra spyi don spyi sgra don mi 'dra zhing / /phyi mar dngos dang dngos med gnyisu brten gsum/ /bye brag don ni de yi bdag gcig 'brel/ /la sogs chos gsum ldan par sde bdun chung / /don spyi dang ni bye brag gang rung tshe/ /phyi mar 'gal phyir dang por thal ba snyam/ /bum par 'gal ba zung la ya min pa/ /de yi ldog pa de dang gcig kyang ngo / /dngos dang 'gal ba ya zung myur yang phye/ /yod par 'gal dang mi 'gal 'brel ma 'brel/ /re re zung gyur yod par ma 'brel ba/ /snga phyi dang ni ya zung kun nas bsdol/ /ka bum gnyis dang 'gal dang mi 'gal sogs//ya ma zung bzhir rtag pa'i ldog pa sogs/ /'di la rtag dngos gnyis mthong du mang bsgres/ /'gal dang mi 'gal tha dad bzhin du med/ /log pa gang rung ji ltar bsdebs kyang mtshungs/ /dngos dang bdag gcig 'brel lam de'i 'bras bu/ /gang rung de 'brel don na nyis mgo phyung / /bdag nyid gcig sgos tha dad brten nas byung / /de med rang yang ldog pa snga phyi'i 'brel/ /yod med 'gal lo 'on te yod par thal/ /tha dad phyir zer tshig gi sbyor tshul skyon/ /'gal ba gang yin tha dad nges na'ang / /'gal 'brel du ma tha dad brgya stong ci/ /me du phan tshun bskyed bya skyed byed kyang / phan tshun bskyed byar 14

phan tshun 'gal bas 'jig /rgyu 'bras gnyis ka yin kyang rgyu 'bras min/ /rigs kyi bye brag yod med rigs spyir— 'gal/ /spyi phyir de dang bdag gcig skabs gzhan 'gal/ /gzhi mthun srid na tha dad yin par nges/ /dngos po kho na med kyang yin pa srid/ /ka bum gnyis dang med pa gang rung ni/ /gcig kyang yin pa mi srid shes bya ste/ /'di dang 'gal ba mu bzhi phyed pa'i 'phrul/ /phas rgol dregs pa 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i thog /rdzas btags chos gsum de las gzhan sbyor na/ /rnam mkhyen tshang ma las ni gzhan du 'am/ /rang gi mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid su yis byed/ /rtag pa dngos po'i mtshan gzhi'i steng du grub/ /rdzas btags chos gsum tshang dang ma tshang ba'i/ /mtshon bya yod kyang tshang dang ma tshang 'gal/ /mtshan mtshon la ni de dag re rer nges/ /log rtog rigs mi mthun sel so sor snang / /btags yod min yang de yi chos gsum tshang / /gzugs rung mtshon bya chos gsum dang po 'am/ /gsum tshan chos gnyis phan tshun mu yang bsnol/ /dngos dang gzugs rung so so'i ldog pa dang / /don gcig mtshan mtshon zung re gzhan yang ngo / /gang gang rdzas btags chos gsum tshang ma tshang / /de de'i mtshan mtshon yin min don ldog go /rdzas kyi btags yod phyi ma'i 'dra ba brtsegs/btags yod lnga pa bzhi pa'i mtshon bya'i don/ /de yi mtsharna mtshon gyur kyang de min dbye/ /rnam par gzhag 'jog rgyu 'bras mtshan mtshon nyid/ /ma khyab khyab rme gzhi la mi gnas skyon/ /mtshan mtshon ltar snang brgyad dang so gnyis skad/ /li ṭa zhes pa mtshan mtshon thun mong sgra—/ /gang gis gang du ci zhig blo yul mtshon/ /mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum zhes grags mtshon sbyor ni/ /gser bum bum pa'i mtshan gzhi ther ba nor/ /gzhi dang mtshan nyid nges sla rdzas btags gnad/ /chos gsum tshang nges mtshan mtshon rtogs min ang / /rang lugs 1/0

mtshan gzhi gser gyi lto ldir ba/ /bum par mtshon te lto ldir ba nyid ces/ /mtshon sbyor rnam dag gzhung mang lta ba'i mig /gangs can smra ba'i khyu mchog cha ba'i lugs/ /rdzas chos rang yin ma yin tsam po ba/ /de dag rdzas mthun dang bcas rdzas ldog brgyad/ /rdzas mthun gnyis pa brgyad las gzhan du 'gyur/ /med pa dang ni rtag pa khyod khyod rang / /snga ma rdzas dang chos min phyi mar dpyad/ /rang ma yin pa ldog ste min pa'ang ci/ /ldog chos la yang dang po gsum ma nges/ /rdzas chos dang ni 'gal sogs phyi ma bzhi/ /rdzas chos la ni de dang mi 'gal nges/ /ldog chos bdun las phung sum pa ni lnga/ /rang min ldog chos de yi rdzas mthun te/ /gsum du bgrangs kyang gang rung ma yin lo/ /rdzas mthun ldog pa'i khyad la smyon na dka'/ /rang yin dang por bgrang tsam rang min ldog /snga ma min pa phyi ma'i rdzas mthun ci/ /rang yin rdzas mthun gang rung rang min ldog /gang rung min ba rang yin rdzas mthun zer/ /phyi ma mi rigs rdzas mthun gnyis par bzhag /tsam po rang min ldog pa rang yin gsungs/ /bum pa'i spyi dang khyod khyod ma yin pa/ /gang rung khyod khyod min yang rang min ldog /'phang tshe 'dod lan rtags ma grub pa'i khyad/ /thol byung lam shes rdzas chos 'dir ma nges/ /khyod khyod yin min tsam po rang min lo/ /bum par 'gal dang mi 'gal zung gyur pa/ /khyod khyod ma yin khyod ma yin pa yang / /khyod du 'gal phyir rang min ldog chos sam/ /de bzhin yod par sbyar ba rdzas ches rigs/ /spyi dang bye brag zung gyur tsam po ste/ /rtag dngos spyi yi bye brag gzhi mthun yang / /rdzas tshos rang na de min rdzas mthun ther/ /shes bya min pa rdzas chos mthun min lo/ /ldog chos rang yin de min rang ma yin/ /rdzas ldog gyur pa'i rtag dngos so sor dbye/ /rtsa ba'i rdzas mthun bzhi dang de yi yang / /gang rung yin min 16

kun rtog mtha' yang bral/ /tshul 'di bzhag dka' phyi ma dpe ston lugs/ /mthun phyir 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i dgongs pa zab/ /snga phyi'i rdzas ldog bsdol te mu yang bzhi/ /rdzas chos rdzas yod mi rtag dngos po 'dra/ /ka bum rang min ldog chos yin min gsung / /pu nyus ldog chos nyid la de dbye 'am/ /rdzas mthun don bcas snga mar bstun nam gang / /nam mkha' rigs pas grub bam rdzas yod kyang / /rtogs btags tsam ste btags yod rdzas ni cha/ /brtan pa mi 'gyur rdzas yod rtag par mthun/ /gang zag rang skya 'dzin mi thub pa'i btags/ /don byed nus pa'i rdzas yod rang 'bras skyed/ /skyes bu rang nyid tshad mas nges pa la/ /rang gi ngo bor ma gyur nges par bstos/ /yod pa'i ngo bor ma gyur gang zhes rtsod/ /gdags gzhi'i phung po ngo bo gzhan min lo/ /skye mched lnga dang shes pa rang skya 'dzin/ /phra rab rdul dang mig sogs mi 'dzin btags/ /med kyang btags yod gsum gyi kun btag go /rdzas chos rtog btags tsam min don byed nus/ /sgras brjod rigs grub brtan pa mi 'gyur dang / /don byed nus dang rang skya 'dzin pa bzhi/ /rang ngos nas grub gnas lug sa ngo bo min/ /rtog btags tsam gyis chos de ldog chos don/ /yongs grub rang ngos gnas lugs min nam brtag /kun btags ldan min yongs grub sgras brjod tsam/ /mi rtag chos dang ldog pa ldog chos min/ /rigs pas grub pa'i btags yod med na yang / /tshad mas grub pa'i de yod rigs pa gang / /brtan par mi 'gyur brtan par klog pa soms/ /rab brtan 'gyur ba mthong ngam rtag par nges/ /ka bum gnyis ka yin na des khyab kyang / /de dag ma yin yod med kun kyang ste/ /gnyis ka yin na gang dran thal bar 'gyur/ /yod med gang rung yin na de yin kyang / /med dang yod par ma nges de dang kun/ /gang 17

ru‘ 4 yin na yod min med pa'ang min/ /yod na med dang ldog dang rtag na de/ /'je/ga med rigs pa'i rnam 'gyur zad mi shes/ /gang dran yin par khas 'ches bzu/ par 'dod/ /bum pa dus kun yod med gang rung yang / /yod min dus kya‘nga ged srid dngos phyir lo/ /yod na rang dus med mod yod nges ci/ /khyab dang dgos dang yin rnams khyad par med/ /khyab mtha'i rnam grangs gnyis kyi ming gis gsungs/ /yod pa yin na chos can bzung ba ni/ /rtsod gzhi skyon can tshig gi sbyor lugs nyes/ /khyab pa'i mtha' zhes mu mtha' yas pa mtshar /rjes 'gal ldog thur phyin ci log bcas brgyad/ /rtags min gsal min kha bub bsnan te bcu/ /ka bum rtag dngos gsal dang rtags su bkod/ /rjes 'gal ldog thur khyab pa sgo bdun nges/ /rjes ldog rnal ma nges dang ma nges dang / /rtag dang yod pa gang zhig dngos po 'god/ /ldog khyab rnal ma gsal min rtags mi spong / /dngos dang gzugs bkod thur khyab gnyis pa nges/ /rjes 'gal rtags de yin na gsal yin ldog /'gal khyab rnal ma nges pa'i thur khyab nges/ /med dang yod pa bkod de thur khyab min/ /'gal khyab yod pa yin na med min khyab/ /med min yod pa 'gal ba'i thur khyab nges/ /rdzas 'gal9bzhi yi gnyis gnyis don gcig go /rnal ma phyin ci log bzhi'i gcig gnyis gsum/ /brgyad dang re bzhi'i bar du mu yang 'phrul/ /de nang don gcig ngos bzung legs kyang dpyod/ /rigs pa'i rgyal po'i rigs lam gter khab lnga(95/ /dngos min rang dang khyod kyi rgyu med phyir/ /yod na 'brel bas shes bya med par 'gyur/ /rang rgyu yod par shes bya gzhir bzung na/ /rang sgras shes bya 'dren te myu gus shes/ /rang gi rgyu med rang rgyu las skyes pa/ /dngos dang don gcig yin pa mi srid chos/ /rang dang gcig gi yin pa yod de rang / /18

bum pa gzhir bzung rang rgyu las skyes dang / /rang gi ldog pa rang dang gcig gam rang / /yin par 'phangs la rtsod gzhi 'phar na 'dod/ /khyod sgra sbyar ba rnams la rkyang par brtsi/ /bdag sgra sbyar ba phal cher sngar 'dra 'am/ /rtsong gzhi 'dir 'dren rwa bsdus min gsung bde/ /bdag dang gang zag yod 'phang khyod gzhi 'dor/ /bdag dang nga dang gang zag don gcig phyir/ /bdag gzhan dgra gnyen gsal byed sde dang sbrel/ /bdag nyid yod 'phangs rang dang khyod kyi 'gros/ /bdag gi 'bras bu bdag gi bskyed bya'o/ /bdag de'i 'bras bu bdag de las skyes te/ /dngos phyir khyod kyi 'bras bu khyod las skyes/ /bum pa dang ni rtag pa gang rung ste/ /dngos po yin kyang khyod dang dngos gang rung / /ma nges bum pa mi rtag pa yis phye/ /khyod dang dngos po gang rung yin na'ang / /dngos por ma nges rnam mkhyede yod pa'o/ /buyo pa chos can khyod dang gcig tu thal/ /bum dang gcig yin de yin khyod dang gcig /yin dgos ther na khyab med lan thebs la/ /dang po gnyis pa bsdoms pa'i rtags ma grub/ /phyi ma'i rtags la bum pa gnyis sbyor 'khrul/ /dngos phyir khyod nyid chos can steng du dngos/ /gzugs tshor la sogs chos can steng du rang / /ka bum yin min gang rung dngos po min/ / yin min gyur pa'i dngos kyang zung re 'gyur/ /phan tshun tha dad gzhi mthun mi srid kyang / /bdag med yin na khyod min ma nges so/ /yod med yin min khas blangs song tshul gzhan/ /rtag par rtogs pa'i tshad ma yod pa dang / /rtag pa don gcig 'on kyang de gnyis 'gal/ /shes bya rtag rtogs tshad ma yod pa dang / /rtag dang tshad ma'i dgag gzhir 'phangs pa la/ /tshad ma khas blangs la yang dgag gzhi 'phar/ /dgag gzhi gnyis sbyar shes bya sum sbyor ro/ /gang zhig khyod yod pa dang khyod med pa/ /rtag rtogs tsha da ma zlog pa med rtogs tshad/ /stag tshang bar shin rnam grangs nyi shur 19

rte// /bum pa bum par gcig ngang tha dad dang / /snga mar ka ba bum pa'i spyi bye sgyug /gnyis kur 'phangs rnams brtsi tshul gang song gces/ /yin min gyur ‘/'i rtags las phyi ma ste/ /snga phyir rtag par nges dang ma nges phye/ /yin par 9sgyus mi len te ma yin pa/ /ma yin pa dang yin pa gnyis dar 'gal/ /de'i rje /ra yin pa dang ni ma yin zung / /dgag sgra gnyis kyis rnal ma go ba'i 'gros//bye gig yod pa ma yin pa rnams gtso/ /ka bum ma yin pa dang ma yin pa/ /gnyi gar 'dod cing spyir btang dngos yin na/ /ma yin pa dang yin par ma 6sgon song / /dngos por de sgra sbyar dang ma sbyar phye / /rtag pa ma yin pa dang nga ngos po dang / /der gyur bdag med ma yin bdag kyang bkag /rnam dbye drug pa thon pa drug sgra'i tshul/ /tshad ma dgag gzhi khyod gshaṭa dri/ sa 'phangs bzhi/ /dris 'phangs drug sgra'i go don dhwa dzas gsungs/ /rnam /khyen gzhir bzung dngos por rtogs pa yi/ /tshad mar 'phangs par chos can 'phar bar 'dod/ /tshad ma yin dang yod pas brtsi tshul gzhan/ /dngos rte gas tshad ma'i rgyu med dngos po la/ /der nges gzung ba'i dus su de 'dzin che/da/ /yod dus yod rtogs med la gzhan du bzheg /rnam mkhyen rtag rtogs tshad ma rnam mkhyen gyi/ /dgag bya yin zhing rnam mkhyen de'i dgag gzhi/ /rtag rtogs tshad ma rtag rtogs gnyis kyi yang / /rtag rtogs tshad ma rtag rtogs tshad ma dang / /gcig min med phyir gzhi med gshog ma tshang / /rnam mkhyen dngos rtogs tshad ma'i dgag gzhi ste/ /dngos rtogs tshad ma med phyir tshad mi/na bsal/ /rnam mkhyen gzhir bzung dngos rtogs yod rtogs tshad/ /ci tsa ma brtsegs kyang yin 'god gnyis tsam 'phar/ /dang sgras bar0bcad gsum ba/zhi yin par 'phangs/ /chos can tshad ma'i grangs kyi rnam mkhyen spel/ /'on kyang dngos rtogs yin min rtogs pa sogs/ /dang sgras ma chod bzhi brtsegs ཿ0

mgo nas lnga/ /rnam mkhyen rnam mkhyen yin rtogs tshad yod kyang / /de de min par rtogs pa'i tshad ma'o/ /min rtogs zung du 'phangs kyang yod min te/ /rnam mkhyen rnam mkhyen ma yin par rtogs pa'i/ /tshad ma min par de yis gzhal min phyir/ /rtsod gzhi med dam blang ba'i khyad par gyis/ /khyab pa ma tshang skyon can lan yang 'debs/ /dngos por rtogs dang yin rtogs yod pa 'dra/ /rnam mkhyen dngos po yin rtogs tshad ma dag /yin par 'phangs la snga phyir rnam mkhyen lhag /dngos rtogs yod rtogs zung ngam lhag na'ang / /snga mar rnam mkhyen zung dang phyi ma ra gcig /yin min rtogs pa zung la snga mar lhag/yin rtogs zung la min rtogs gsum sbyar mnyam/ /yod rtogs drug sgra yin rtogs snga mas bcom/ rnam mkhyen dngos rtogs zung dang yod rtogs zung / /snga phyir rnam mkhyen zung dang gcig sbyor te/ /gnyis tshig zab ste gzhi mthun 'tshol bar song / /dang sgras ma chod rnam mkhyen zung las min/ /tshad ma min la 'di yi 'phar rtsis ched/ /rnam mkhyen chos can gcig rtogs tshad ma dang / /tha dad rtogs pa'i tshad mar 'phangs pa la/ /de sgra sbyar cing gsum 'phar 'dod lan thebs/ /gcig rtogs zung gyur gnyis rtogs yod med khyad/ /yod phyir gcig rtogs tshad dang tha dad nges/ de yis gnod pa'i skyon gnyis rim bzhin spong / /dgag gzhi drug sgrar brtsi tshul rnam grangs drug /bzhi sbrags mtha' skyer dmigs hur pang len ma/ /rgyab khur shong rdzong grags kyang bzhi sbrags gtso/ /yab sras gsung ngag me long ngos su gsal/ /yul dus gnas skabs dgag bzhi'i gnas rnams tshang / /bum pa med pas bum pa med par smos/ /dus de yod sar dgag gzhir mi rung bas/ /de ltar go rgyu'i gnad don dgag gzhi'i nus/ /yul dus rang bzhin ma 'dres sogs kyis shes/ /bum pas dag phyogs bum pa med pa'i phyir/ /bum dang rdzas gcig tha dad gang 21

yang min/ /bum pa'i dgag gzhir shes bya zung gyur kyang / bum pa'i dgag gzhi rtag pa yod sogs bkod/ /bzhi sbrag dbang byas 'dod pa'i lan yang thebs/ /dgag gzhir rnam mkhyen dngos rtogs tshad sbyar na/ /tshad ma'i nus lhag rnam mkhyen gnyis sbyor shes/ /rtag rtogs dgag gzhi de yang med pa dang / /yod rtogs yod par 'phangs pa'i 'gros kyis shes/ /drug sgra gnyis bsres gzhung tshan 'khrul te rtsod/ /dgag gzhi re re'am phyi mar khyod sgra sbyar/ /rtag par 'phangs pa'i khyad par 'dis mtshon nas/ /gsal ba'i khyod sgra gang yod rtsod gzhi re/ /gzhi dang gsal bar dgag gezhi'i grangs kyis 'phar/ /bzhi sbrags chos can steng du chos can de/ /rtsod gzhi'i steng du gsal ba de yin par/ /brtsi zhing dris 'phangs mtha' ni 'gal khyab bsdu/ /thal 'gyur rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ldan dang / /chos can gsal rtags spungs dang spubs 'tshang lnga/ /phyi mar chos can gsal bas gnyis su dbye/ /skor 'bebs zhes grags rtags sogs gsum ldan gsum/ /sbyar ba'i rtags khyab grub tshul dpyod pa'i 'phrul/ /chos can spungs sogs re rer snga btsan sogs/ /grags kyang rang lugs chos can snga btsan dang / /gsal bar bar btsan rtags la phyi btsan bzhed/ /gsal ba ya byung dbus ma gsal bar bstan/ /sbubs gnyis gsal rtags phyir sgra snga ma yis/ /chos can gsal ba'i phyi nas rim par bsdus/ /rtags gsal re tsam thal ngag med pa'ang rung / /rtags gsal tha dad bkod pa'i thal 'gyur dang / /rtags gsal tha mi dad pa mu bzhi ste/ /song bkod rtags gnyis grub tshul la'ang bzhi/ /bdag med yica na dngos po yin par thal/ /dngos po yin phyir zhes pa'i rtags su nges//bum pa chos can zlos kyang rtags gsal gzhan/ /snga ma'i rtags meng 'o na kyang dngos po de/ /sgra sogs gzhir bzung rtags des 'gal khyab ste/ /dgag gzhi 22

can la mi 'dra rtag par sbyor/ /chos can zung la dngos po zlos gyur kyang / /rtags gsal tha dad 'phangs dang dris pagazhan/ /dngos po gsal ba dngos po rtags byas pa'i/ /rtags gsal gnyis ldan tha mi dad ma nges/ /sgra phyir de mi rtag dang sgra mi rtag /zlos te bkod pa'i rtags kyi khyad par phye/ /chos can zung steng khyod sgras dang po 'khrid/ /yod pa rtags sogs bkod pa'i thal 'gyur dang / /gcig min nges la bzlog ste ma nges shing / /'phangs tshe rtsod gzhi yod pa med dang gzhan/ /khyod sgra zung la rang nyid rang dang gcig /thal 'gyur min yang de dang gcig mi 'gal/ /dngos la rang rang gcig yin mi rtag nges/ /dngos por thal ba de dang gcig tu 'dod/ /thal ba snga na chos can gzhan yod kyang / /rtsod gzhi med pa mi 'thad sngar bzhin rigs/ /dngos po yin te dngos yin gang dran no/ /sgra bzung 'phangs tshe chos can dor zhing 'dod/ /gsal spungs min nam thal ngag phyir na sgra/ /thal ba gsum dang phyir sgra gcig bkod tshe/ /chos can mi 'khrid sogs bkod rtags gang dpyad/ /thal ba mang yang gsal spungs mi 'gyur phye/ /thal ba bzhi bkod rtags khyab grub sbyar spungs/ /snga phyir chos can zung gyur 'dra ba yang / /brtsi tshul mi mthun khyod sgras gang 'khrid gzhan/ /gsal ba'i phyir sgras chos can rim par drangs/ /thal 'gyuji rang gi chos can gsal ba 'am/ /chos can gsal ba'i nang 'gyur rtsod gzhi med/ /thal 'gyur gnyis 'brel sbubs 'tshang min la gang / /phyir sgra bzhi yis snga mas phyi ma tsam/ /sgra bzung khyod sgra yod med khyab pa yang / /phyir sgra snga ma'i grangs kyi thal ba 'tshang / /thal pa gnyis la sbubs 'tshang mi 'dod 'khrul/ /gcig tsam phyir sgra stong gi 'dren min no/ /chos can zung dag bsnol min khyod skus bsnyegs/ /snga bcan tshul dang mi 'gal zhib tu dpyod/ /khyod dngos zung bkod thal 'gyur khyod khyod dang / /gcig tu 23

'phangs pa'i khyod sgra 'dren tshul dang / /nus pa 'phar ba'i gzhi gsal ma 'dres phye/ /dris pas 'dod dang 'phangs pas gzhan gyur pa'i/ /brtsi tshul mi mthun snga phyi legs par rtog /khyod sgra zung sbrel shes bya yod pa yang / /chos can gcig la dris 'phangs med par gsungs/ /dgag gzhi khyod sgra zung dag sbrag pa yi/ /'phangs pa'i lan ni nor ram brtag dgos gsungs/ /rtsod gzhi gsal bar dgag gzhi'i nus pa re/ /'phar nas bzhi sbrags gcig bsnartsa mtha' skyor ma/ /bum pa'i dgag gzhi gzugs sgra sogs bzung ste/ /dris 'phangs lnga bdun 'phyug med bde zhes gsungang / /smras pa/ rnam grol rin chen 'dod pa'i don mthun tshogs/ /rmongs pa'i dra ba gcod pa'i 'khor lo dang / /sun 'byin rlung gis mi g.yo lhun po'i dbang / /chig don kun gzigs rgyal ba'i sras bzhin mdzod/ /de ltar rtogs pa 'phel bas rang rgyud tshiyo/ /grags snyan gsung zhim 'thul bas 'jig rten dga'/ /cho sa kyi rgyal srid skyong ba'i dpal gyis mtho/ /kun gyis mchod 'os 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /ces bya ba ni mchog tu spro ba bskyed pa'o/ /chos kun da lta gong 'og tshul mang yang / /'dus byas da lta don gcig grub mtha' gsum/ /bum ba'i dus su 'das dang ma 'ongs pa/ /de ru ma nges de yi rgyu dang 'bras/ /'on kyang de dag bum pa'i 'das sogs min/ /dus gsum rdzas sam 'das sogs rtag pa'o/ /skye la mngon phyogs skye dgos skye bzhin pa/ /med kyang myu ga la sbyar yod ces gsungs/ /dngos kun 'gag la mngon phyogs skye dang 'gag /zin ngang tshar ba'i tha snyad ma 'dres 'tshal/ /'jig dang 'gags zin 'jig dgos 'jig bzhin brtag /sa bon 'gags dang myu gu skye ba mnyam/ /myu gu skye na sa bon ma 'gags nges/ /sa bon myu gu'i min mod las nyon 'dra/ / dngos rgyu skad cig dang po skye dus te/ /snga ma skye kha 24

ma yi dus kyang ngo / /'jig dub/ 'gag dus 'dra yang yod dus min/ /skad cig tha ma 'jig dus 'gag dus min/ /mngon du phyogs gsungs gzhan du yin par gsungs/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum zhig dus lhan mtshungs dpyad/ /rnam mkhyen skye dus de thob 'tshang rgya brtag /snga phyi ba/sum phyir gnyis pa rang dus na//tshad ma rjes dpag rgyun mtha' zhib tu phye/ /dus gsum 'gro ba shes bya'i dngos kyang rtog /skad gcig gnyis pa 'bras dus ma nges glog /'das dang ma 'ongs bskal pa bstos nas sam/ /zhig dang 'gags pa'i dngos dang shi ba'i mi/ /med kyang lha mi shi ba gang du yod/ /mi bsad sems can gang zag bsad pa dang / /de dag shi dang skye dang 'gag pa dpyod/ /srog na bang ma 'gags na'ang glang dar bsad/ /'on kyang ma shi ba rnams shi ba gang / /'das pa'i sangal rgyas med kyang dus kyi zer/ /'gro kun dus gsum sangs rgyas cis mi 'gyur/ /skye la ma 'gag da lta ba yi don/ /skye 'jig dus kyang brgyud pa'i rgyu 'bras min//dngos gang skye ba'i rgyu yod ma skyes cha/ /ma 'ongs dngos gang zhig cha 'das pa'i don/ /zhig pa yin yang yod phyir ma zhig go /ma 'ongs ma 'ongs pa med 'das pa yang / /rtag pa rkyen ma tshang ba'i ma skyes dpyad/ shi ba'i lus yod dus dang dngos don gcig /rtag phyir dus bral de phyir rang dus med/ /smra mkhan la bstos da lta ha cang thal/ /'das sogs snga phyi grub pa'i tshul la rtog/rang mtshan mngon sum dngos gzhal don dam bden/ /dngos rnams don gcig rtog btags tsam du 'gal/ /rtogs btags spyi mtshan ma nges med pa yang / /chos kun yul dus rang bzhin ma 'dres pa/ /spyi mtshan rtag dang kun rdzob bden pa 'dra/ /shes pa rgyun dang bum pa rags pa'ang ste/ /skad cig snga phyi phra rab mang 'dus phyir/ /rdzas rdul 'dir med snga phyi tshogs na 'grogs//phra rab rgyun 'chad tha ma rags rgyun min/ /rags rgyun rtag kyang yin na mi rtag

nges/ /cha bcas cha dang cha can tha dad du/ /mngon sum pa ni snang min shugs kyis rtogs/ /shes bya phyogs bcu dus gsum chos kun la/ /rjes su 'gro phyir kha cig 'dod tshul 'khrul/ /tha snyad grub pa'i tha snyad sgra rtog nyid/ /don dam tha snyad tshad ma mngon rjes rim/ /mngon sum tshad ma'i ngor bden don dam ste/ /rtog btags tsam min chos ni kun rdzob bden/ /kun rdzob bden pa'i kun rdzob rtog pa ste/ /don dam bden pa'i don dam mngon sum mo/ /shes kun nyams myong rang rig tshad ma min/ /chos kun rang rang steng gi gzhan dbang ste/ /rang steng kun btags min yang rtog btags so/ /sgra rtog btags tsam ma yin rang mtshan don/ /rang mtshan ma rtogs de ru grub rtogs brtag /dgag bya bcad dang don spyi brgyud min par/ /mngon sum tshad mar 'char bar nges sam dpyad/ /shar nub snga phyi'i dus dang rang bzhin la/ /rjes su 'gro yang cha rnams phan tshun min/ /don dam don byed nus pa don dam bden/ /gzhan dbang rkyen gzhan las skye rang dbang min/ /skye ba ngo bo nyid med de dang gcig /rtog btags tsam gyi chos ni spyi mtshan no/ /sgra don spyi mtshan don gcig skabs kun brtag /phra rab phyogs cha med pa legs par rtog /rdul phran phra rab bdun tsam 'dus pa'o/ /rdul dang mi rtag phra rags 'jog tshul gzhan/ /rang gi bdag nyid dus cha dang bcas rgyun/ /kun btags rtog pas btags tsam de nyid min/ /rnam grangs mtshan nyid yongs chad rnam pa gnyis/ /yod na rang bzhin rang ngos nas grub la/ /rtog pa'i dbang bzhag don mthun gsungs par brtag /bum pa rtog pas bzhag kyang btags pa min/ kha cig sgro skur tshad mas bsal ba zer/ /gzugs brnyan snang ltar med kyang bden pa'o/ /yongs grub bdag gis stong pa'i de bzhin nyid/ /'gyur med phyin ci ma log yongs grub gnyis/ /rang gi mtshan nyid der grub 'phangs pa la/ /rang sgras rtsod 26

sazhi 'dren gsungs skabs kun dpyod/ /kun rdzob rdzun pa kun rdzob bden pa'o//don dam bden la kun rdzob rdzun nam rtog /yongs grub rang ngos nas gru/ba gnas lugs min/ /sel sgrub 'jug min gang zag gzugs can dbang / /bye brag rnams kyang spyi sgra'i 'jug gzhir nges/ /sgra rtog 'jug gzhi zhen yul mur yang phye/ /sgra rtog sel 'jug yin yang sgra la gnyis/ /gang de yin pa de 'dzin zhen yul lo/ /med dang yongs grub dgag pa'i rtog par dpyad/ /bum 'dzin rtog pa rtogs pa'i blo ru yang / /sel 'jug cha 'ga' yul byas ma byas na/ /rtog pa'i yul min gzugs dang shes bya med/ /sgrub 'jug tshad min bcang shes log shes kyang / /rjod byed sgra dang blo 'jug tshul gnyis nges/ /rang yul sel sgrub 'jug la der ma nges/ /sel sogs mi 'jug sel 'jug sogs kyang brtag /yul gyi dgag sgrub yul gyur ma yin khyad/ /rgyan ni chos kun 'jug la gzhan yang dpyod/ /srog chags sna tshob95 kha dog dbyibs kyang ngo / /rjod byed sgra dag sel 'jug 'dir nges gsungs/ /rtog pas snang btags gcig tu 'dres nas 'dzin/ /brda dus ming dang tha snyad dus kyi don/ /sbyar nas 'dzin pa ming sbyor rtog pa'i don/ /khyad gzhi khyad chos sbyar 'dzin don sbyor te/ /snga phyi mu bzhi sgra spyi don spyi dang / /sngon 'dzin rdzas gcig skye mched gzhan la min/ /bdag med khyad bcas brtag go rdzas brgyad kyang / /rang mtshon nus par 'dod pa'i lugs gnyis rtog /rang yul dngos ngabang 'jug blo sgrub 'jug don/ /rtog med phyin ci log dang ma log gnyis/ /rang yul 'dod dbang 'jug pa sel 'jug don/ /de min bcad nas 'dzin dang brjod par byed/ /sgra dang grub bde rdzas kun sgra 'dzin yul/ /mthong lam la yang sel 'jug sgrub 'jug gnyis/ /gangs can sga 'dzin mi rtag ma rtog kyang / /zla gnyis snang ཿ1

bzhin mi rtag pa yang ngo /rigs brjod tshogs brjod sgra gnyis mu bzhi ste/ /chos dang chos can brjod pa'i sgra gnyis kyang / /bdag med dge sdig gnyis kyi khyad chos so/ /gzhi gcig la'ang sgra gnyis mi 'gal mod/ /ngo bo bya ba brjod dang rtog pa dbye/ shes bya zhes brjod bum sogs spyi ming ste/ /dngos su ma brjod 'jug gzhi dngos su'ang 'jug /dngos ming yin na thun mong min par go /btags ming phyir na don de min par 'gyur/ /'on kyang mi 'gal gcig la gzhi mthun med/ /dngos ming 'jug kyang de min de'i ldog pa/ /mi yi ming la seṅga'i ming min yang / /go rgyu'i dgos pa ming gi don gyis brtag /med pa go na rnam kun mkhyen pas go /lung gis thar pa med pa brjod rung ngam/ /sgra don rang ming dngos kyi brjod byar nges/ /ba lang zhes brjod yi ge gsum phye'i min/ /brda yi dbang gis go bya brjod bya'i don/ /de dang gzhal bya yul rnams don yang gcig /rang yul go byed mnyan bya rjod byed sgra/ /rigs brjod tshogs brjod rang yul spyi de brjod/ /spyi de brjod kyang rigs brjod sogs ma nges/ /gcig la 'gal yang 'khrugs zhes brjod pas dpyad/ /gsum phye'i ming ni don gyi dngos tsam brjod/ /tshig ni don dang khyad par sbyar nas so/ /yi ge ming tshig rtsom gzhi'i skad kyi gdangs/ /dbyangs gsal thon mi'i gsung bzhin slob pa dgos/ /med pa don nam ngo bo 'dzin pa dang / /ma zin 'byung ba'i tshig gi yi ge ci/ /'dod pa'i dbang gis chos dang chos can brjod/ /khyad gzhir blo yul mi spong pa dang spong / /tshig phrad sgo nas mi ldan rnam gcod dang / mi srid gzhan ldan rnam gcod sgra dang gsum/ /khyad gzhi khyad chos tshig phrad sbyor bas dbye/ /phrad med nag pa srid sgrub 'phong skyen no/ /mi srid rnam gcod gzhan ldan nges sam brtag /med kyang mnyan bya yin pa sgra kho na/ /sgra gsum ཿ

don mthun don mi mthun kyang ngo / /sgra tshad seṅge mjing bsgo' e ma mtshar/ /dngos la sgrub par ma nges mi rtag pa/ /rtag pa dngos su bcad nas sgra rtog 'jug /med tshig sbyar yang chags med ma yin dgag /dgag tshig med pa nam mkha' chos nyid kyang / /rang min bcad kyang dgagaḥbya bcad nas min/ /bum brjod dgag sgra gzhan sel sgra ma yin/ /med dgag sgra yi sgrub pa dngos brjod rung / /'gal zla ston pa'i dgag sgra rdzun tshig kyang / /ma yin dgag dang sgrub pa dngos dang shugs/ /gnyis gar 'phangs dang skabs stobs ma yin dgag /bdag med yod dang tshon pos nyin mi za/ /de yang lus ni rid pa ma yin la/ /rgyal rigs ston 'dod bram ze min par brjod/ /med dgag rang sgras chos bzhin med dgag 'phen/ /ldog pas gzhan te de min bzhan du'ang gsungs/ /bram ze chang mi 'thung ba med dgag go /byas brjod rgyu rkyen gzhan 'phen sgrub pa'o/ /sgra dang rtog pas gzugs min bcad nas 'jug /dgag bya bcad nas rtogs dgos dgag pa'i don/ /ldog pa sel ba gzhan sel don gcig la/ /rang zhes brjod pas dgag bya bkag shul du/ /ma yin dgag gam sgrub 'phen mi 'phen gnyis/ /snga mar bzhi dang phyi ma dang bcas lnga/ /de yang dgag sgra dgag pa bcu bzhi gcig/med dang gzhan dang 'dra ba dman dang zhum/ /zhan phra nyung myur chung dang lhag ma med/ /mtha' dag ma yin mi mthun gnyen po bral/ /bco lnga brgyad nas gnyis kyi bar du 'du/ /chos nyid bdag tu 'dzin pa dgag rtog na/ /bdag med 'dzin pa ma yin rgyu mtshan dka'/ /dngos su 'dzin pa rnam pa 'char nges sam/ /rang sgras dgag bya dngos min dgag pa gnyis/ /dgag sgra tshig gis chos gzhan gcod nges sam/ /dgag tshig 'phags bod skad kyis dbye bas brgyad/ /bstan bya'i gtso bo yod kyang dngos kyi med/ /tshul 'di yul dang dgos pa sgra dang dus/ /gnas skab / dgag bya

stos pa nges tshig gis/ /shes phyir yab rje'i legs bshad sgron me bsten/ /rgyu 'bras rigs mi mthun sel ldog pa dang / /snang ba tha dad pa yis gzhan sel te/ /sgra don dang ni de min rnam par bcad/ /blo dang med dgag sel ba med pa'i yang / /gang gi sel ba yod na rang mtshan 'gyur/ /de yi sel ba de min log pa'i rang / /ka bum rtag dngos stong sbyar shugs gzhal dka'/ /dngos po min las log pa rang mtshan du/ /yab rjes gsungs kyang 'dir min mkhas grub dgongs/ /blo don rtog pa'i dngos yul med dgag shugs/ /rang mtshan sel ba'i gzhi mthun don rang mtshan/ /dngos gyur dgag pa rang mtshan gzhan sel 'dra/ /dgag tshig can gyi dngos kun rang mtshan sel/ /rtog pa'i snang yul blo yi gzhan sel yang / /khyod 'dzin rtog par khyod ma yin pa las/ /log par snang ba blo'i sel sgra spyis brtag /me da dgag sel ba med dgag don gcig la/ /rang gi dgag bya bcad tsam sel ba don/ /don de min dang bkag pa'i khyad kyang dbye/ kha cig rtag min log pa de'i gzhan sel/ /bum par de min med kyang dbyibs rdzas yod/ /mtshan mtshon ka bum min par bsgrub pas gzhig/ /'gal dang phan tshun spang 'gal don gcig la/ /dngos 'gal dbye ba sgras brjod phung gsum med/ /phyi ma dngos su gnod bya gnod byed zhugs/ /snang mun tsha grang ji bzhin 'gal tshul gnyis/ /dbye ba gzugs shes ldan min gyur pa'i gsum/ /lhan min 'gal yang de min me du gnyis/ /bdag 'dzin bdag med dngos su rtogs pa'i blo/ /phan tshun ma nges tshul yang zhib par rtog/rgyun gcod mi byed dngos su mi gnod dam/ /lho gling snang bas byang mun ji ltar sel/ /zla 'od rang gi gsal bya'i mun pa dang / /dngos su 'gal yang spyir min nyi 'od brtag /tsha grang snga phyi thad ka bsnol te dbye/ /de bzhin 0

bdag med rtogs dang bdag 'dzin yang / /tsha reg snga ma grang reg phyi ma'i rgyu/ /cha grang lhan cig gnas kyang mi gnas 'gal/ /nus mtshungs 'grogs min lhan cig mi gnas 'gal/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i gnod bya gnod byed sgos/ /'di gnyis phan tshun spangs pa'i brgyud 'gal lo/ /tsha grang du ba grang reg stobs chen dag /gcig yin gcig shos gcod nus phan tshun 'gal/ /dngos brgyud 'gal ba kun kyang 'di yi yin/ /don de rnam par bcad ldog yin min sbyar/ /dang po rnam bcad yongs gcod sgo nas 'gal/ /rtag dang mi rtag byas dang rtag pa rim/ /gnod byed rnams la bsal bya'i zhes kyang sbyar//'dab chags zung gi rgyal pham ma nges bkag /byams pas dngos su gnod kyang dngos gnyen min/ med pa rtag dang mi rtag phung sum mo/ /bden pa'i khyad chos ci rigs 'phen pa'i phyir/ /rgyan sogs mi 'dod thal ba 'phen pa'i sgra/ /thal 'gyur min yang bka' bstan thal 'gyur mang / /thal ngag med pa rtags tsam bkod pa sogs/ /sun 'byin thal 'gyur ma nges bzlog ste nges/ /lan rnams sun 'byin ltag chod lan ltar snang / /dbye na bcu bzhi 'dras mtshungs nye bar mkho/ /sbyor bar shes 'dod chos can bsgrub bya'i chos/ /thal bar rtsod gzhi gsal ba zhes sbyar legs/ /thal rang 'byed chos 'gangs yang 'di na gda'/ /thal sbyor 'gal yang rtags tsam gnyis kur rung / /sbyor bas mi rtag 'phen phyir thal ba brtag /rtags gsal tshad grub sgrub byed 'phen par 'gal/ /rtags sbyor yang dag rang phyir thal bar yang / /sgrub byed 'phen pa khyad chos gsum dang ldan/ /dngos khyab ma grub thal sbyor yang dag med/ /thal sbyor yang dag de min rtags med phyir/ /gzhan du yang dag ltar snang du mar 'gyur/ /skabs su bab pa'i rgol bar mi 'dod pa'i/ /thal ba 'phen pa'i rigs gnas thal 'gyur don/ /yang dag ltar snang bdun zung 'god tshul sgos/ /chos log chos can steng du rtag log pa/ /bsgrub la 81

tshul gsum 'phen dang mi 'phen gnyis/ /dang por ldog pa rang rigs 'phen babazhi/ /gzhan rigs 'phen pa brgyad zung dngos shugs kyi/ /thal sbyor 'dra dang mi 'dras rnam par dbye/ /rtags khyab gsal med smad pa'i dpe min par//gsal ba gsum 'bab gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor/ /lan bzhis rnam thar sgo bzhi dbye ba rmad/ /gzugs ni rgyu drug nang gi gnyis tsam yin/ /rnam smin rgyu min gzugs phyir lung ma bstan/ /mtshungs ldan phal cher sems dang sems byung nges/ /nyon mongs can min phyir na kun 'gro min/ /gang gi lhan mtshungs phyir na de'i rgyur 'gal/ /lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras phan tshun yang / /rnam smin rgyu ni mi dge zag bcas dge /rnam smin skyed byed rnam smin rgyu yang min/ /srog la rang 'bras rnam smin yod nges sam/ /bye smras gzhi kun byed rgyu rang las gzhan/ /ngape ston skye gnas 'phel byed dus mnyam 'ang 'dod/ /dmigs dang de ma thag rkyen bcas phyir shes/ /mtshungs pa gsal rig chos kyi rnam pa brtag /dngos de'i rgyu bdag rkyen gsum don gcig bzhed/ /rkyen bzhi 'bras bu bzhi yang mi 'gal lo/ /ngamigs rkyen yul de'i rnam can byed pa'i rkyen/ /bdag rkyen sngo sogs 'dzin par thun min bskyed/ /thun mong bdag rkyen dbang po gzhan yang ngo / /shedzo/ phyir rang gi bdag rkyen yid dbang yod/ /bum sogs rgyu yi shes pa rnam mkhyen dpyad/ /sngon pos sngo 'dzin gsal zhing rig par bskyed/ /sngon po de 'dzin rtogs pa'i dmigs rkyen min/ /de yi dmigs rkyen snga rol bag chags gsungs/ /rnal 'byor mngon sum kun mkhyen yi shes kyi/ /dmigs rkyen rang rgyu zhi lhag grangs med tshogs/ rtog med log shes dmigs rkyen 'jog tshul mang / /thar pa bral 'bras de dang 'gog bden 'dra/ /rnam smin 'bras phyir lung ma bstan du gyur/ /rgyud kyis bsdus shing rgyu 'bras bar yang chad/ /skal mnyam rgyu ni 'bras dang rigs gcig phyir/ /gzugs shes ldan min rigs lnga'i 32

'gror yang brtag /thar pa byed 'bras bye smras 'dod kyang min/ /skyes bu'i byed 'bras med pa'i dngos po med/ /byed rgyu lhan cig 'byung dang skal ba mnyam/ /rnam smin kun 'gro mtshungs ldan rgyu drug go /skye la phan 'dogs rigs gnas byed pa'i rgyu/ /tshogs pa gcig sgos phan 'dogs lhan cig 'byung //rdzas gcig tha dad sgo nas rnam pa gnyis/ /rang 'bras rigs 'dra skyed byed skal mnyam rgyu/ /rang gi skal mnyam rgyu med de yi rgyu/ /byed rgyu lhan cig skal mnyam dngos por gcig /mtshungs ldan sgo nas phan 'dogs mtshungs ldan rgyu/ /gzhan rigs shes dang don gcig rnam lngas mtshungs/ /kun 'gro rang dang sa gcig nyon mongs bskyed/ /nyan mongs dang ni mtshungs ldan sems yang gsungs/ /rang gi rnam smin 'bras bskyed rnam smin rgyu/ /dge dang mi dge rang 'bras bde sdug skyed/ /rgyu bdag dmigs pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen/ /rim bzhin rang 'bras bskyed dang dbang yang byed/ /yul gyi rnam ldan gsal zhing rig par bskyed/ /rgyu bdag dmigs rkyen dngos po don gcig la/ /de bzhin rang gi rgyu bdag rkyen yod kyang / /de ma thag rkyen shes par don gcig cing / /rang gi dmigs rkyen de ma thag kyang ngo / rnam smin rgyu mthun byed bdag bral ba'i 'bras/ /byerdo bdag 'bras bu 'dus byas phan tshun nges/ /rgyu mthun sa dang rnam pa 'dra ba ste/ /zag med dang po ma gtogs rgyu mthun 'bras/ /bral 'bras shes rab stobs kyis spang bya zad/ /rnam smin rgyu la gnyis las phung sum med/ mtshungs ldan 'du byed mtshungs ldan rgyur ma nges/ /bdag 'bras thun mong rnam smin thun mong min/ /sdod kyang dge dang mi dge'i bdag 'bras mang //nyer 'bras rgyun dang lhan cig byed 'bras gzhan/ /mkhyen gsum bsgom pa'i rnam smin chos kyi sku/ /smras pa/ rab 'byam gzhung lugs gting dpag dka' ba'i mtshor/ /bde blag 'jug pa'i rigs tshul gru gzings 'di/ /bsten pa'i blo gsal bye 38

ba'i dga' ston ni/ /sras bcas rgyal kun dgyes pa'i mchod sprin nyid/ /thub bstan gzugs kyis mdzes pa'i rmongs bral zhing / /blang dor phyed pa'i rnam dpyod yid kyi bzos/ /shes ldan blo gros me long mdzes pa'i dpal/ /ye shes gzigs pa'i rgya las ji ltar 'gong / /mdor na sgo gsum rnam dkar bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /kun bzang spyod pa'i rgya mtshor lhan cig pas/ /phan bde'i rin chen mdzod du rab rdzogs nas/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i bzhed dgu 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni mkhyen gter ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i bsdus gzhung 'dab stong padma legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis reg pas ji dgar grol ba'i 'dzin bde ba zhig dgos thes sgo mang mkhan spru' 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgya mtsho dang / sku 'buca/ mkhan zur gro tshang dpon slob/ gzhan blo gsal ba du mas kyang yang yang bskul bas byang mtha'i rigs smra dka' bzhi ba su dhi pra sha gas rab tshes chu stag nyin byed dbang po nya khyim du spyod pa'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum par/ phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos kyi sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni rnam dpyod yangs pa'i a rig dge slong skal bzang sbyin pas bgyis pa 'di yang / 'jam mgon ring lugs phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig dpyad gsum rnam dag bsdus gzhung bsdoms tshig 'di/ /thar 'dod sher phyin 'bras bzang smin slad du/ /gzhung zhabs rtse mgron thub bstan mkhyen rab kyis/ /sngon med par gsar dga' ston deng 'dir bsgrubs/ /tshul 'dir 'bad la dung dang kun da ltar/ /rab dkar dge ba ji snyed bsags pa de/ /pha ma rigs drug nyam thag ma lus pa/ /myur du rdzogs byang thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bsdus gzhung bsdoms tshig 'o ma'i chu gter cher/ /lung rigs skya 'degs shes bya'i grur zhugs te/ /bka' pod lnga yis rin chen gling bgrod nas/ /sa lam mthar phyin sku gsum gyur thob shog / //par 'di bkras lhun par khang du bzhugs/ sab dza gti//84

༄7// tshad ma'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos chen po rnam 'grel gyi don gcig tu dril ba blo rab 'bring tha ma gsum du ston pa legs bshad chen po mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan skal bzang re ba kun skong zhes bya ba bzhugs so//ngag dbang bkra shis kyis brtsams pa/

bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir tshad ma'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos chen po rnam 'grel gyi don gcig tu dril ba blo rab 'bring tha gsum du ston pa legs bshad chen po mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan skal bzang re ba kun skong zhes bya ba 'di nyid rtsa 'grel chabs sbrags su 'god par bya ba la thog mar shes bya la 'jug pa'i sgo'am lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul mtshon byed ni/ bsdus grwa'i rtsa tshig dwangs shel me long du/ (gsham du mdor bsdus te‘‘rtsa tshig tu ’zhes 'god rgyu yin)shes bya'i rnam pa kun gsal snang ba'i mdzod//ye shes dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'bum/ /thar 'dod blo yi chu skyes bzhad pa'i dpal/ /yab rjes 'jam dbyangs bla mas dge legs rtsol/ /ces rang gi bla mar mchod par brjod pa'o/ /bstan bcos kyi khyad chos brjod pa'i sgo nas bshad par dam bcas pa ni/rtsa tshig tu/mtha' yas gsung rab gting zab yangs pa'i mtshor/ /bde blag 'jug pa'i rig lam sku ma'i 'phrul/ /thub bstan kun gsal bzhin ras mjes pa'i rgyan/ /blo gros lang tsho dar ba'i mchod thin spel/ /zhesaso/ /bstan bya gzhung gi bsdus don ni/ rtsa tshig tu/tshad ma'i gnad bsdus tshogs pa bsdus pa'i grwa/ /'di la sbyi don bye brag de nyid sde/ dbang pos rigs lam chung sogs mtshan 37

gzhir brtag /mi mthun smras pa'i zhe 'dod dpyod pa'i dngos//gang la gang gis rtsod pa snga phyi'i rgol/ /rgyu mtshan gang gis gang du ci zhig rtsod/ /rtags gsal rtsod gzhi zhes grags rtog ge'i skad/ khams dang skye mched phung po mkhas bra'i gnas/ /rang dbang bdag mi dmigs pa bdag med don/ /yod med kun te shes bya yod pa chos//gzhi grub don gcig tshad mas grub pa dang //rang gi ngo po 'dzin dang tshad mas dmigs/ /blo yo yul du bya rung ldog ste rim/ /dbye ba rtag dngos rang spyi bden pa gnyis/ /'jig med chos ne rtag go gzhi mthun dpyad/ /res 'ga' ba dang rnam pa bams cad gnyis/ /don byed nus pa dngos po'i don te gsum/ /gzugs shes ldan min phung po lngar yang dbye/ /gzugs rung gzugs kyi mtshan nyid phyi nang gnyis/ /shes rgyud kyis bsdus ma bsdus gzugs rung spyor/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phyi yi lnga/ /mig shes sogs kyi bzung bya rim bzhin don/ /dang por kha dog dbyibs gnyis nyi shur yang / /kun btus mngon par skabs yod phra rags jul/ /rig byed nam mkha' rgyan gsung snga phyir brtag /sgra la zin pa'i 'byung 'gyur de las gzhan/ /ston dang snyan par zla bcas bzhi tshan gnyis/ /rjod byed sgra ni brjod bya'i don go byed/ /ja sgra khyad can yin min ston dang gzhan/ /lhan skyes sbyar byung dri yang zhim dang min/ /ro la rtsa ba yan lag nying lag gis/ /drug dang dgu bzhi brgya rtsa re gsum gsungs/ /bcu gcig reg bya 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyis/ /rang 'bras rnam shes bskyed pa'i rigs gnas kyi/ /nang gi gzugs can dang ba mig dbang 38

sogs/ /rang yul mthong ba ten bcas de mtshungs ga'an/ /bsdus dang skabs yod yang dag blangs pa dang/ /kun btags dbang 'byor chos kyi skye mched gzugs/ /gsal zhing rig pa shes pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /tshad ma tshad min blo rig drug dang bdun/ /tshad ma gsar du mi bslu ba yi shes/ /mngon rjes gnyis so tshad min lnga yang dbye/ /'du byed gang zhig mtshungs par mi ldan pa'i//rigs su gnas pa ldan min 'du byed don/ /gang zag dang ni de min dngos po sogs/ /'di dag tshad bsdus don gyi lus so zungs/ /zhes tshig rkang bzhi bcu zhe drug gis bstan cing / de dag re re bzhin bshad pa la rnam gzhag nyi shu rtsa drug tu phye ba bstang chags su bkod pa 'di ltar ro/ /dang po/ dbyibs dang kha dog gi rnam gzhag bshad pa sna/ rtsa tshig tu kha dog dmar sngon sogs su ma bes te/ /chos dung dkar po tshe mtha' yas pa'i mdog /rtsa ba'i mdog bzhi 'dren tshul nag por dpyad/ /dmar ser ljang gu yan lag brgyad las gzhan/ /de dag dmar ser nag dang ser po'i cha/ /dri ro gzugs kyang kha dog skye mched min/ /rdul du grub pa bem po'i mtshan nyid de/ /mdog dang dbyibs su rung ba kha dog dbyibs/ /dkar dmar sngo ser rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi/ /yan lag sprin dang du ba rdul khug sna/ /snang myan grib ma nyi ma'i 'od zer brgyad/ /phra rab zul nas nyi zer rdul bar gye/ /khug sna 'ja' tshon na bun lho 'ur ma/ /nyi 'od snang ba de bzhin phyi nang brtag /ring thung mtho dma' lham 39

spum phywa le min/ /rtsa ba yan lag mdog gnyis mu bzhi ste/ kha dog dbyibs kyang de bzhin dkar dmar dang / /sa chu sogs la mu bzhi'i gnyis re 'byung / /'byung ba sra zhing 'bas pa rlan zhing gsher/ /tsha zhing speg pa yang zhing g.yo ba bzhi/ /'byung 'gyur 'jam rtsub lci yang grang bkres skom/ /yang ba 'byung 'gyur 'on kyang rlung yang de/ /rnam 'grel lci yang gzugs nyid sdig lci rtog /rta dkar gang zag phyir na dkar po min/ /rtsod gzhi blang dang khyod sgra'i zhib cha gces/ /gser ni sra zhing 'thas mod sa ma yitsho/ /bsreg dang 'jal la mi mthun smras pa mtshar/ /phywa le ba de yin min dngos 'gal te/ /dgag sgra zung dang yin min log pas phye/ /zhes pa ste/ /gzhan lugs dgag pa/ kha cig na re/ kha dog yin na dmar po yin pas khyab zer na/ chos dung dkar po'i kha dog chos can/ dmar po yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ chos dung dkar po'i kha dog chos can/ kha dog yin par thal/ dkar po yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ chos dung dkar po'i kha dog chos can/ dkar po yin par thal/ chos dung dkar po'i kha dog dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ chos dung dkar po'i kha dog chos can/ dmar po ma yin par thal/ dkar po yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal/ dkar po dang dmar po gnyis kyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ dkar po dang dmar po gnyis kyi gzhi mthun med par thal/ dkar po dang dmar po gnyis 'gal ba yin pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi kha dog chos can/ dmar po

yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi kha dog chos can/ kha dog yen par thal/ ser po yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi kha dog chos can/ ser po yin par thal/ sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi kha dog dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi kha dog chos can/ dmar po ma yin par thal/ ser po yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal/ dmar po dang ser po gnyis 'gal ba yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ kha dog yin na dalar po yin pas khyab zer na/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi kha dog chos can/ dkar po yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi kha dog chos can/ kha dog yin par thal/ dmar po yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi kha dog chos can/ dkar po ma yin par thal/ dmar po yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi kha dog chos can/ dmar po yin par thal/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi kha dog gi ldog pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi kha dog chos can/ khyod khyod kyi ldog pa yin par thal/ khyod gzhi grub pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i kha dog choja 4 na/ dkar po yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i kha dog chos can/ kha thog yin par thal/ ljang khu yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ sangs rgyas doo yod grub pa'i kha dog chos can/dkar po ma yin par thal/ sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i kha dog dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ rtsa ba'i kha dog yin na/ rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi po gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/ na ga po chos can/ rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi po 41

gang rung yin par thal/ rtsa ba'i kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ nag po chos can/ rtsa ba'i kha dog yin par thal/ nag po yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ nag po chos can/ rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi po gang rung ma yin par thal/ dkar po ma yin pa gang zhig ser po yang ma yin/ dmar po yang ma yin/ sngon po yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po ma grub na/nag po chos can/ dkar po ma yin par thal/ nag po yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal/ dkar po dang nag po gnyis kyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ nag po chos can/ ser po ma yin par thal/nag po yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal/ ser po dang nag po ba/nyis 'gal pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma gnyis la rigs 'dra/ kha cig na re/ yan lag gi kha dog yin na/ yan lag gi kha dog brgyad po gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi kha dog chos can/ yan lag gi kha dog brgyad po gang rung yin par thal/ yan lag gi kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi kha dog chos can/ yan lag gi kha dog yin par thal/ dmar po dang ser po gnyis kyi yan lag gi kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi kha dog chos can/ dmar po dang ser po gnyis kyi yan lag gi kha dog yin par thal dmar ser yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi kha dog chos can/ yan lag gi kha dog brgyad po gang rung ma yin par thal/ sprin dang du ba/ rdul dang khug sna bzhi po gang rung ma yin pa gang zhigasnang ba dang mun pa/ grib ma dang nyi ma'i 'od ther bzhi po gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags re re nas grub ste/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi kha dog dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / ljang khu chos can/ yan lag gi kha ‘2

dog brgyad po gang rung yin par thal/ yan lag gi kha dog yin pa'i phyir/khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ ljang khu chos can/ yan lag gi kha dog yin par thal/ nag po dang ser po gnyis kyi yan lag gi kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ ljang khu chos can/ nag po dang ser po gnyis kyi yan lag gi kha dog yin par thal/ ljang khu yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ ljang khu chos can/yan lag gi kha dog brgyad po gang rung ma yin par thal/ ljang khu dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ gzugs yin na kha dog yin pas khyab zer na/tsarnan gyi dri chos can/ kha dog yin par thal/ gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ tsarnan gyi dri chos can/ gzugs yin par thal/gzugs rung yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal/ gzugs rung gzugs kyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ tsardon gyi dri chos can/ kha dog ma yin par thal/ dri yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal/ dri dang kha dog gnyis kyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/tsandan gyi dri chos can/ der thal/ dri dang kha dog gnyis 'gal ba yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ gzugs yin na gzugs kyi skye mched yin pas khyab zer na/ sgra chos can/ gzugs kyi skye mched yin par thal/ gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ sgra chos can/ gzugs yin par thal/ bem po yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sgra chos can/ bem po yin bar thal/ rdul du grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal/ rdul du grub pa bem po'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ sgra chos can/ gzugs kyi skye mched ma yin par thal/ mig shes kyi gzung bya ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sgra chos can/ mig shes kyi gzung bya ma yin par thal/ rna shes kyi mnyan bya yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sgra chos can/ rna shes kyi mnyan bya yin par 43

thal/ sgra'i skye mched yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / bu ram gyi ro chos can/gzugs kyi skye mched yin par thal/ gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ma grub na/ bu ram gyi ro chos can/ gzugs yin par thal/ ro yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga po gang rung yin na gzugs yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ bu ram gyi ro chos can/ gzugs kyi skye mched ma yin par thal/ mig shes kyi gzung bya ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal/ mig shes kyi gzung bya gzugs kyi skye mched kyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ /rang gi lugs la/ gzugs kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ gzugs rung de yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs dang bem po gnyis don gcig gzugs la dbye na gnyis yod de/ phyi'i gzugs dang nang gi gzugs gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ phyi'i gzugs kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ skye bo'i shes rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i gzugs de yin pa'i phyir/ phyi'i gzugs la dbye na lnga yod de/ gzugs kyi skye mched dang /sgra'i skye mched dang / dri'i skye mched dang / ro 'i skye mched dang / reg bya'i skye mched dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs kyi skye mched kyi mtshan nyid yod de/mig shes kyi gzung bya de yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs kyi skye mched la dbye na gnyis yod de/ dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dbyibs la dbye na brgyad yod de/ ring po dang thung ngu / mtho ba dang dma' ba/ lham pa dang blum po/phywa le ba dang phywa le ba ma yin pa dang bcas pa brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ lham pa gzhag tu yod de/ gru bzhi lta bu'i dbyibs de yin pa'i phyir/ thum po gzhag tu yod de/ gor gor ram sgo nga lta bu'i dbyibs de yin pa'i phyir/ phya le ba gzhag tu yod de/ ngos mnyam pa'i dbyibs de yin pa'i phyir/ phya le ba ma

yin pa gzhag tu yod de/ ngos mi mnyam pa'i dbyibs lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/kha dog la dbye na gnyis yod de/ rtsa ba'i kha dog dang / yan lag gi kha dog gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i kha dog la dbye na bzhi yod de/ dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang sngon po bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ yan lag gi kha dog la dbye na brgyad yod de/ sprin dang du ba/ rdul dang khug sna/ snang ba dang mun pa/ grib ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ kha dog dang dbyibs gnyis ka yin min gyi mu bzhi yod de/ kha dog yin la dbyibs ma yin pa'i mu dang / dbyibs yin la kha dog ma yin pa'i mu dang / kha dog dang dbyibs gnyis ka yin pa'i mu dang / dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis ka gang yang ma yin pa'i mu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ kha dog yin la dbyibs ma yin pa'i mu yod de/rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi po de yin pa'i phyir/ dbyibs yin la kha dog ma yin pa'i rmu yod de/ ring po dang thung ngu lham pa dang blum po bzhi po de yin pa'i phyir/kha dog dang dbyibs gnyis ka yin pa'i mu yod de/ sprin dang du ba/ rdul dang khug sna bzhi po de yin pa'i phyir/ dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis ka gang yang ma yin pa'i mu yod de/ sa chu me rlung bzhi po de yin pa'i phyir/ gzugasu kyi skye mched dang / gzugs kyi khams dang / bstan yod kyi gzugs gsum don gcig bstan yod kyi gzugs kyi mtshan gzhi yod de/ kha dog dang dbyibs gnyis de yin pa'i phyir/ kha dog dang dbyibs gnyis chos can/ khyod la bstan yod kyi gzugs zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mig gi yul du bstan du yod pas na de ltar du brjod pa yin pa'i phyir/ sgra'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rna shes kyi mnyan bya de yin pa'i phyir/ sgra la dbye na gnyis yod de/zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra dang / ma zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra gzhag tu yod de/45

skyes bus thal mo brdabs pa'i sgra de yin pa'i phyir/ ma zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra gzhag tu yod de/ chu sgu de yin pa'i phyir/ sgra la rjod byed kyi sgra'i sgo nas dbye na gnyis yod de/ sems can du ston pa'i sgra dang / sems can du mi ston pa'i sgra gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sems can du ston pa'i sgra dang /rjod byed kyi sgra gnyis don gcig mtshan gzhi ni yod de/ sgra mi rtag ces brjod pa'i sgra de yin pa'i phyir/ sems can du mi ston pa'i sgra dang rjod byed kyi sgra ma yin par gyur pa'i sgra gnyis don gcig mtshan gzhi ni yod de/ rnga'i sgra dang dung gi sgra la sogs pa de yin pa'i phyir/ dri'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid yod de/sna shes kyi myong bya de yin pa'i phyir/ dri la dbye na gnyis yod de/ lhan skyes kyi dri dang sbyar byung gi dri gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ lhan skyes kyi dri gzhag tu yod de/tsardon gyi dri de yin pa'i phyir/ sbyar byung gi dri gzhag tu yod de/ sbyar spos kyi dri de yin pa'i phyir/ lhan skyes kyi dri la dbye na gnyis yod de/ zhim pa'i lhan skyes kyi dri dang mi zhim pa'i lhan skyes kyi dri gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ zhim pa'i lhan skyes kyi dri gzhag tu yod de/ gur gum gyi dri dang ga bur gyi dri gnyis lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ mi zhim pa'i lhan skyes kyi dri gzhag tu yod de/ shing kun gyi dri dang mu zi'i dri gnyis lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ spyor byung gi dri la dbye na gnyis yod de/ zhim pa'i sbyar byung gi dri dang mi zhim pa'i sbyar byung gi dri gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ zhim pa'i sbyar byung gi dri gzhag tu yod de/ sbyar spos dang dbus spos kyi dri gnyis lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ mi zhim pa'i sbyar byung gi dri gzhag tu yod de/ sman dri mi zhim pa mang po sbyar ba'i dri de yin pa'i phyir/ ro'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ lce shes kyi myong bya de yin pa'i phyir/ ro la dbye na drug yod de/ mngar ba dang skyur ba/ kha ba dang bska ba/ tsha ba dang lan tshwa ba drug yod pa'i phyir/ mngar ba gzhag tu yod de/ bu ram gyi ro dang 'o ma'i

ro lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ skyur ba gzhag tu yod de/ skyu ru ra'i ro dang zho'i ro lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ kha ba gzhag tu yod de/ tig ta'i ro lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ bska ba gzhag tu yod de/ a ru ra'i ro lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ tsha ba gzhag tu yod de/ sman tsha ba gsum gyi ro lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/lan tshwa ba gzhag tu yod de/ ba tshwa dang sog tshwa'i ro lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/reg bya'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ lus shes kyi myong bya de yin pa'i phyir/ reg bya la dbye na gnyis yod de/ 'byung bar gyur pa'i reg bya dang /'byung 'gyur du gyur pa'i deg bya gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'byung bar gyur pa'i reg bya la dbye na bzhi yod de/ sa chu me rlung bzhi po de yin pa'i phyir/ sa'i mtshan nyid yod de/ sra zhing 'thas pa de yin pa'i phyir/ chu'i mtshan nyid yod de/ rlan zhing gsher ba de yin pa'i phyir/ rma'i mtshan nyid yod de/ tsha zhing sreg pa de yin pa'i phyir/ rlung gi mtshan nyid yod de/ yang zhing g.yo ba de yin pa'i phyir/ 'byung 'gyur gyi reg bya la dbye na bdun yod de/ 'jam pa dang rtsub pa/ lci ba dang yang ba/ 'grang ba dang bkres pa/ skom pa dang bdun po de yin pa'i phyir/ nang gi gzugs kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ skyes bu'i shes rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i gzugs de yin pa'i phyir/ nang gi gzugs la dbye na lnga yod de/ mig gi dbang po dang / rna ba'i dbang po dang / sna'i ngabang po dang / lce'i dbang po dang / lus kyi dbang po dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ mig gi dbang po'i mtshan nyid yod de/ rang 'bras mig shes kyi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i nang gi gzugs can dngas pa de yin pa'i phyir/ mig dang mig gi dbang po dang / mig gi khams gsum don gcig mig dbang la dbye na gnyis yod de/ rten bcas kyi mig dbang dang /rten mtshungs kyi mig dbang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rten bcas kyi mig dbang 47
